movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Tickle
movelist.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and lower the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Baton Pass
movelist.effect: The user is replaced with another Pokémon from their trainer’s roster. All Combat Stage, Coats, and [Stratagems] on Baton Pass’ user are transferred to the replacement. Baton Pass may be used to switch even if the user is Trapped.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by an opponent with a Melee
abilities.effect: If the opponent has a Held Item and the user does not, the user takes the Held Item the opponent is holding.
